title: Zscaler Cellular (SIM and Cellular Edge) Licensing and Fair Use

blocks.text: Zscaler Cellular is a Software as a Service (SaaS) product that is licensed according to the number of cellular devices being protected and the data usage of the protected cellular devices for the subscription term in an order.

A cellular device is an endpoint with a Zscaler SIM (or e-SIM). The number of protected cellular devices is determined by the number of Zscaler SIMs purchased from Zscaler (for Zscaler SIM) or unique IP addresses accessing Zscaler Cellular Edge (for Cellular Edge).

A data pool is purchased for the protected cellular devices. This data pool can be used by any SIM/IP address assigned to that data pool. The data pool resets on the first day of each calendar month, and unused data is not carried over. For subscriptions beginning after the first day of a calendar month, the data pool and billing for the initial partial month will be prorated based on the number of remaining days in that month.

Ensure that you order the correct number of SIMs, IP addresses, and data usage as needed. If additional SIMs, IP addresses, or data usage are needed during a subscription term, contact Zscaler Sales or your Channel Partner. Zscaler monitors and periodically reviews the number of protected cellular devices and their bandwidth usage to ensure license compliance.

The usage of Zscaler Cellular is expected to be in accordance with the Acceptable Use Policy. If data usage exceeds the data pool limit within a calendar month, the service will continue without interruption and an overage charge will be incurred automatically at the pre-agreed rate per GB as specified in the applicable Order Form (such overage charges will co-term with the remainder of the Subscription Term). Overage charges are uncapped unless otherwise expressly stated in the applicable Order Form.

blocks.item: You are solely responsible for monitoring and managing your data usage.
Zscaler does not provide real-time usage alerts, spending caps, throttling or automatic service suspension.
Any usage dashboards or visibility tools Zscaler may provide are for informational purposes only and do not limit your payment obligations, including any overage charges.
